judge.rationale: The candidate delivers a complete, working implementation that satisfies every acceptance criterion, including the test that asserts a static schema is compiled once across 10 executions (which the reference diff actually omitted). It properly compiles static schemas at registration time, caches dynamic schemas in a WeakMap, formats validation errors without leaking input values, and updates all required documentation, specs, and the changelog. Compared to the reference, the candidate introduces an extra test file (`registry.acceptance.test.ts`), leaves `.lore/dod.md` in the tree, bumps `package.json` version directly, and modifies `adrs/ADR-002-response-validation.md` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` (to keep line-number links valid after inserting the new orchestrator test in the middle of the suite rather than at the end). Despite these minor structural differences, the core design in `ToolRegistry` and overall behavior closely match the reference.
